headline: Catawba shut out Mars Hill and top the table
dek: Catawba have scored fourteen goals, more than any other programme, and conceded three in four wins and a draw. On Saturday they held Mars Hill without a goal in a conference match. Anderson, the only other unbeaten side, have also won four and drawn one, and the two do not meet until October.
displaced_by: Catawba beat Mars Hill, the conference's top scorers, in a conference match and now lead the goal chart on fourteen.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Wingate's twelve goals have come from nine different scorers, and no one of them has more than Austin Vicenzino's three.

wire.line: Only Anderson and Catawba remain unbeaten; Emory & Henry still have no published result at all.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and every match Emory & Henry have had so far, the latest at home to Palm Beach Atlantic.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Newberry have lost all five of the matches that carry a result, scoring twice and conceding thirteen. Giuseppe Gereau and Shotaro Sekinada are the only players to have scored for them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Wingate have scored twelve and conceded four in three wins and two defeats, and followed a home defeat to Francis Marion with a win at Middle Georgia State.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lincoln Memorial's Daniel Benedek Miklosi has made twenty saves and conceded five, without yet keeping a clean sheet.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Carson-Newman's Elijah Buford has made eighteen saves and conceded two goals.

last_match.line: Catawba remain unbeaten and have yet to concede in a conference match; Mars Hill had not won since their trip to North Greenville.

next_match.line: Anderson are unbeaten; Emory & Henry have no published result from any match yet.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
